description: Signing of an Addendum to the existing Agreement with the United Nations Conference on Trade and Development (UNCTAD) for the development of the Automated System for Customs Data System (ASYCUDA System)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Following the recommendations of the International Monetary Fund for structural adjustments with emphasis on automation in 1991, Sri Lanka Customs adopted the ASYCUDA System for revenue collection. Subsequently, the Government of Sri Lanka has adopted the ASYCUDA system developed by the United Nations Conference on Trade and Development (UNCTAD). Five support Agreements have been signed previously between Sri Lanka Customs and UNCTAD, the sole organization providing expertise for the ASYCUDA system, for technical assistance and further development of the system. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to sign the 6th Addendum to the existing Agreement between Sri Lanka Customs and UNCTAD to extend the period of technical assistance provided by UNCTAD until June 2027, to upgrade the currently used ASYCUDA World system and to conduct two training programmes for relevant staff of Sri Lanka Customs on the functioning of the ASYCUDA and ASYHUB systems, was approved by the Cabinet.
